evals.name: gap-issue-pr-chinese-body
evals.expected_output: Fixture `ideate-gap`: in one /ideate update run the user corrected (a) no list of what changed in `idea.md` — a gap, step 8 reports only paths — and (b) a Spring Boot Starter + Redis delivery the user never stated, despite the existing no-guessing rule; plus one `git rm` pathspec ERROR (weak, single). Restores the upstream workflow skills with `./skillsw install` in the clone and runs them from its `.agents/skills/`, then opens one ideate Issue + PR whose authored prose is Chinese while the template skeleton stays English, lists the weak error as below the gate, retrospects itself, then asks whether to sync.
expectations: Runs `transcript.py digest` and `transcript.py meta` before drafting lessons
Reads ideate from a fresh clone/worktree of `jinsyin/skills`, with default branch from `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef`
Creates exactly one Issue + PR pair for ideate, titled `<type>(ideate): …`, with labels `self-improve` and `ideate`
Issue body keeps headings `## Target`, `## Context`, `## Evidence`, `## Root cause`, `## Proposed change`, `## Checked` in English
Issue body keeps field keys (`Skill:`, `Change type:`, `Source project:`, `Agent runtime:`, `Retrospected sessions:`, `Improvement run (`) in English
Evidence table header is exactly `| # | Step where it went wrong | What happened | Signal |` and its Signal cells are `strong`/`weak`, not 强/弱
Context keeps `claude-opus-5-5/high` and the run's own `<model>/<effort>` untranslated
Evidence cells, root cause and proposed change are written in Chinese
PR body keeps `## Change` and `## Checklist` headings and English checklist items, with Chinese change notes and `Closes #<issue>`
Branch is `self-improve/ideate-<issue#>`

Classifies the missing change list as a gap and the invented Starter/Redis as a rule that exists but did not fire (rewords the existing passage, adds no second no-guessing rule); lists the `git rm` pathspec error as below the gate
Retrospects the self-improve run itself (step 6) before wrap-up
Ends with a skill · lesson · Issue · PR table and asks whether to sync changed skills into the project
Runs `./skillsw install` in the clone before step 5, then runs the skills the upstream `CLAUDE.md` workflow names from the clone's `.agents/skills/`, without skipping any as unavailable
Opens no `no-pr` record Issue, since the run filed an Issue + PR

evals.name: dry-run-report-only
evals.expected_output: Same fixture as eval 0. Prints a report in the Issue structure — Chinese prose, English skeleton — and still runs step 6, without creating any Issue, label, branch push or PR.
expectations: Runs no `gh issue create`, `gh label create`, `gh pr create` or `git push` (not even stubbed)
Prints each would-be Issue body as the filled template: `## Target`, `## Context`, `## Evidence`, `## Root cause`, `## Proposed change` headings, English field keys and exact table header
Report prose (evidence, root cause, proposed change) is in Chinese and Signal values stay `strong`/`weak`
Report includes a self-improve self-retrospective section

evals.expected_output: Fixture `pr-merge-rule-not-fired`: github-pr-merge already makes CI a Gate finding, but the agent twice recommended Merge on red CI. Verdict is 'rule exists but did not fire': rewords/moves the existing Gate rule instead of adding a duplicate, ships Issue + PR with the language split.
expectations: Loads the self-improve skill from the natural-language request
Classifies the lesson as rule exists but did not fire, citing the existing Gate/CI passage of github-pr-merge
Proposed diff edits the existing CI rule's wording or placement rather than appending a second CI rule
Diff contains no ALL-CAPS MUST/NEVER and keeps growth ≤ ~20% of the file
Issue Evidence Signal cells read `strong`, and prose cells are Chinese

Issue + PR carry labels `self-improve`, `setup-rules` and `brainstorming`
Cites the digest's HEAVY-SKILL tokens/wall time as evidence
Lists cost evidence one row per run, with the `[heavy-turn]` fields in/out tokens, calls, compactions, peak-ctx and subagents
Opens no Issue or PR for caveman-commit (auto-invoked, light), mentioning it only as a summary/below-gate note
Tells the user to run `setup-rules update` to refresh `CLAUDE.local.md`

Opens no `no-pr` record Issue, since the run already commented on #99
